Okay I think I got it.
Notetags are missing in your database : <srpgClass:x> and <srpgLevel:x>.
Even if it's "dummy" the core need thoses informations for status windows. Try to add this.
Maybe there are other problems, but this if one of them.

posts.author: AngelYuko
posts.body:
Okay I think I got it.
Your mistake is to put <type:enemy><id:x> in the event notetag.
You have to remove "x" and use the id of the enemy.
Exemple : you want to put a bat in this évent, you must put <id:1>.
You want an orc ? Put <id:4>.
Also, your <srpgLevel> notetag is wrong. You must put a number and not only a X.
All your ennemy units must have à number in the <id:> notetag. If not, the game Will crash.
